name: Betty Joyce Forester (Oxenger)
sources: Ancestry.com, public member tree "Cox Family Tree" (tree 17224056)
notes: Daughter of Glenn C. and Ruth (Borton) Forester. Born 26 Apr 1926 in Hillsdale County, Michigan; married Richard Oxenger on 19 Dec 1943 in Steuben County, Indiana; died 4 Aug 1989 at Fremont, Indiana; buried at Ransom, Hillsdale County, Michigan.
